title: 四核 IRIW · 3×2 mesh
description: 实际 XiangshanCore / 私有 classic L2，4 RN-F / 4 HN-F / 2 SN-F；两个 SAM 均来自仿真配置。

threads.title: P0
threads.code:
.option norvc
.text
.global _start
_start:
  li s0, 0x100000000
  li s1, 0x200000000
  li t0, 1
  sd t0, 0(s0) # x = 1
  fence rw, rw
  addi t3, s1, 1024
  sd t0, 1024(t3)
1: j 1b

threads.title: P1
threads.code:
.option norvc
.text
.global _start
_start:
  li s0, 0x100000000
  li s1, 0x200000000
  li t0, 1
  sd t0, 64(s0) # y = 1
  fence rw, rw
  addi t3, s1, 1024
  sd t0, 1024(t3)
1: j 1b

threads.title: P2
threads.code:
.option norvc
.text
.global _start
_start:
  li s0, 0x100000000
  li s1, 0x200000000
  li t0, 1
  ld t1, 0(s0) # r0 = x
  ld t2, 64(s0) # r1 = y
  sd t1, 1024(s1)
  sd t2, 1032(s1)
  fence rw, rw
  addi t3, s1, 1024
  sd t0, 1024(t3)
1: j 1b

threads.title: P3
threads.code:
.option norvc
.text
.global _start
_start:
  li s0, 0x100000000
  li s1, 0x200000000
  li t0, 1
  ld t1, 64(s0) # r0 = y
  ld t2, 0(s0) # r1 = x
  sd t1, 1024(s1)
  sd t2, 1032(s1)
  fence rw, rw
  addi t3, s1, 1024
  sd t0, 1024(t3)
1: j 1b

sam.description: RN→HN: CMN SCG XOR (PA48)；HN→SN: PA[6] XOR PA[12]。

refinement.chironCoverage: E.b fields and supported transaction joints; Issue H WriteEvict/Stash/CleanShared and implicit DataPull use project flow checks
refinement.issueHCoverage: finite h-extended-256 identity, retry credit, aligned small accesses, BE, DataPull and payload checks
